name: Turnshoes
description: Standard soft-soled daily footwear suitable for settled environments and light walking.
narrative_effects: Provides baseline footwear for town and indoor use with no special protection.

name: Waxed Turnshoes
description: Weather-treated turnshoes with tougher soles and improved wet-weather performance for working use.
narrative_effects: Supports everyday outdoor work and light travel in variable weather.

name: Court Shoes
description: Formal footwear crafted for court, ceremony, and noble gatherings.
narrative_effects: Supports formal social framing in elite or ceremonial settings.

name: Boots
description: Standard rugged boots for travel, labor, and common outdoor use.
narrative_effects: Provides reliable footwear for road travel, field work, and general outdoor conditions.

name: Reinforced Boots
description: Tougher boots with added support and durability for marching, combat, and hard wear.
narrative_effects: Supports sustained marching and rough terrain with improved ankle support and sole durability.

name: Field Boots
description: High-end all-weather boots built for maximum durability, protection, and sustained outdoor use.
narrative_effects: Supports extended field operations in harsh conditions with maximum foot protection and weatherproofing.

name: Gloves
description: Standard leather gloves for daily work, travel, and general use.
narrative_effects: Provides baseline hand protection for work, travel, and ordinary handling.

name: Reinforced Gloves
description: Tougher gloves with added padding and durability for labor, combat, and rough handling.
narrative_effects: Supports sustained heavy labor and rough handling with improved grip and impact padding.

name: Field Gloves
description: High-end all-weather gloves built for maximum durability, protection, and sustained hard use.
narrative_effects: Supports extended field operations with maximum hand protection and weatherproofing.

name: Cloak
description: Standard outerwear for travel, weather protection, and everyday use.
narrative_effects: Provides baseline weather cover and warmth for road travel and outdoor activity.

name: Waxed Cloak
description: Wax-treated cloak with better weather resistance for rough travel and wet conditions.
narrative_effects: Supports travel in rain and wet conditions without soaking through quickly.

name: Field Cloak
description: High-end reinforced cloak built for maximum durability, protection, and sustained outdoor use.
narrative_effects: Supports extended field operations in harsh weather with reinforced construction and full weatherproofing.

name: Court Cloak
description: Formal high-status outerwear for nobles, ceremonies, and appearances at court or elite gatherings.
narrative_effects: Supports formal social framing and status signaling in elite or ceremonial settings.

name: Common Clothes
description: Simple everyday clothing worn by laborers, farmers, and ordinary folk.
narrative_effects: Provides baseline unremarkable appearance appropriate for common settings.

name: Work Clothes
description: Sturdy practical clothing designed for physical labor, yard work, and trade use.
narrative_effects: Supports manual labor and trade work without premature wear.

name: Traveling Clothes
description: Practical road-ready clothing acceptable in most ordinary social settings.
narrative_effects: Provides baseline acceptable appearance for travel and most everyday contexts.

name: Fine Clothes
description: Well-made formal clothing suitable for elite, ceremonial, or high-society settings.
narrative_effects: Supports social checks in formal or elite environments where appearance signals status.

name: Ceremonial Vestments
description: Formal vestments crafted for religious ceremonies, sacred rites, and devotional occasions.
narrative_effects: Supports sacred and ceremonial framing where devotional attire carries institutional weight.

name: Hearthwool Cloak
description: A warm traveling cloak of Hearthgoat wool — the Feywood's standard cold-weather outerwear, durable across decades of ordinary use.
narrative_effects: Maintains warmth in cold and damp conditions appropriate to extended Feywood and western-forest travel.
Recognizable at a glance to elves; its presence signals Feywood origin or long elven-contact.

name: Ceremonial Elven Robe
description: A formal robe worn by elves for observances, oath-marking events, and Council-facing business — woven from fine elven plant-fiber textiles with subtle house-identifying weave patterns.
narrative_effects: Signals ceremonial presence at observances and formal civic occasions.
Specific weave patterns encode house affiliation readable by trained elven eyes.

name: Moonthorn Pelt Cloak
description: A cloak of moonthorn wolf pelt — made only from a wolf's natural death, never from a hunted pelt; the pelt's origin is known to all who understand the Feywood's relational ethics.
narrative_effects: Provides significant cold-weather protection.
Earned rather than purchased — appearing in realm trade is essentially impossible; a moonthorn pelt cloak on a non-elf is a question in itself.
Elves reading the cloak's origin correctly treat the wearer with specific attention regardless of their other signals.

name: Vaelmere Trader's Overcoat
description: The Vaelmere-standard trader's overcoat — a practical blend of elven tailoring and realm-trader utility, designed for long Border transit and sustained cross-cultural work.
narrative_effects: Maintains warmth across Border crossings and realm-side travel.
Cut signals Vaelmere origin to realm traders who work regularly with the Feywood; a visual shortcut that smooths negotiations.

name: Elven Forest Boots
description: Soft-soled high-laced boots of elven construction — quiet on forest floor, durable across long travel, shaped for the specific terrain elves cross routinely.
narrative_effects: Supports quiet movement on forest terrain; noticeably less noise than realm-standard boots on leaf litter and undergrowth.
Common carry for elves traveling realm-side; their soft tread is often the first nonvisual indicator an elf has entered a space.

name: Thornfiber Belt with Pouches
description: A sturdy belt of woven Thornfiber Cane with fitted pouches for field gear — the Feywood's standard traveling belt, widely worn by rangers, gatherers, and Vaelmere residents.
narrative_effects: Carries small gear (Silverleaf Balm, fire kit, small tools, field notes) in organized fashion.
Thornfiber weave is weather-resistant and maintains shape across long service.
